description: Plan your attacks wisely with real-time troop stats
population-info: Please don't forget the Dragon bonus when adding population!
exclude_info: Exclude troop types enemy is strong than (≥ threshold)
please_select_troops: Please select troops and enter a valid population.
please_select_monsters: Please select monsters and enter a valid dominance.
please_select_mercenaries: Please select mercenaries and enter a valid authority.

userManual.overviewText: This application helps players strategize optimal troop distribution against various enemy squads. Input your resources, select enemies, and receive calculated troop distributions.

gettingStartedPoints.label: Language Selection:
gettingStartedPoints.text: Use the dropdown to switch between English and Turkish.

gettingStartedPoints.label: Info & Manual:
gettingStartedPoints.text: Click the ℹ️ or 📘 button to open help modals.

inputsControlsPoints.label: Enemy Squad Filters:
inputsControlsPoints.text: Choose enemy squad by level, category, and name to filter available troops.

inputsControlsPoints.label: Leadership:
inputsControlsPoints.text: Enter your total available troop leadership value.

inputsControlsPoints.label: Dominance:
inputsControlsPoints.text: Enter your total available monster leadership value.

inputsControlsPoints.label: Enemy Strength Threshold:
inputsControlsPoints.text: Exclude troops that are too weak compared to the selected enemy.

inputsControlsPoints.label: Clear Button:
inputsControlsPoints.text: Resets saved troop selections and inputs from local storage.

inputsControlsPoints.label: Manual Button:
inputsControlsPoints.text: Opens this user manual for quick reference.

userManual.troopSelectionIntro: Troops are grouped into types and selected with checkboxes.

troopTypes.label: Monsters:
troopTypes.text: Dominance-based units like dragons or elementals.

userManual.troopSelectionNote: Check the boxes to include troops. Selections appear in the result tables below.

resultsPoints.label: Main Troop Distribution:
resultsPoints.text: Calculated using leadership input. Strongest units prioritized.

resultsPoints.label: Monster Distribution:
resultsPoints.text: Calculated using dominance input. Supports main troops with monster power.

featuresPoints.label: Persistence:
featuresPoints.text: Your inputs and troop selections are automatically saved in local storage.

featuresPoints.label: Filtering:
featuresPoints.text: Enemy squad filters narrow down troop options dynamically.

tipsPoints: Select an enemy squad first to auto-filter weak troops.
Use a threshold like 30% to balance risk and strength.
Combine troop and monster units for better strategy.
Click 'Clear' to reset when results seem off.

troubleshootingPoints.label: No troops visible:
troubleshootingPoints.text: Ensure you selected an enemy squad and have troops checked.

troubleshootingPoints.label: Incorrect results:
troubleshootingPoints.text: Try clicking the clear button and re-entering values.

troubleshootingPoints.label: Language not updating:
troubleshootingPoints.text: Use the language dropdown in the top-right navigation bar.
